status.next: Install hooks after the original 128K unpacker without carrying game code.

pacing.result: HALT slack ranges from 128 to 70,272 T. Median 30,936 T.

feasibility.decision: Stage 1 paused at the packed original. Keep the plain rebuild available as a diagnostic only.
feasibility.next_experiment: Install after unpacking. Compare all eight banks at first title entry against the original and require zero unexplained byte changes for each option.
